annotations.identity: Green, quiet forest that turns wild toward the edges. Glade and autumn: bright meadows round the outpost, old trees in the middle, a pine ridge and wooded hills to the north. Its trouble is beasts pushed out of the hills, and goblins behind them.
annotations.poi: Ranger Outpost; Woodcutters' Camp; Bear's Den; Panther's Den; The Old Trees; Abandoned Camp; Expedition Camp; Trappers' Camp; Snare Lines; Survivor's Hide; Cave Track (to the Gnawdeep).
annotations.structure: Hub: the ranger outpost (ranger-outpost area_3), where new characters arrive. Difficulty rises outward: the outpost's maps first (elvl 0-1), then the old growth, ridge and eaves (2-3), the hills last (3-4), which lead up to the Gnawdeep.

description: Forest full of wild creatures, with a few human camps. The starting zone.

name: Thornwood

annotations.intent: Thornwood's bear's den (S4, the woodcutter's axe), and the odd lone bear in deep woods. A solo, at the open budget (300 HP, 8.3 dps with Maul and Swat).

black-bear.description: A big black bear, protective of its den and in no mood for visitors.
black-bear.name: Black Bear

powers.description: A wide swat that catches everyone in front of it.
powers.name: Swat

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand: 1.5x the panther's HP (225), with a second phase below half health.
annotations.intent: S3's named mob, in its den in Thornwood. A bigger, harder-to-spot panther (stealth 5, against the stock panther's 0): players should find it before it finds them.

black-panther.description: A huge black panther that's been stalking the camps: you rarely see it before it pounces.
black-panther.name: The Black Panther

powers.description: Leaps on its prey from the shadows.
powers.name: Pounce

powers.description: Wounded and cornered, it fights in a frenzy.
powers.name: Cornered

annotations.intent: Thornwood's boar runs (L1): pairs and small herds in thickets and clearings. Gore is the charge; the pair hits hard up front, then tapers.

boar.description: A bristling wild boar: it charges first and thinks never.
boar.name: Boar

powers.description: Charges in and rips with its tusks.
powers.name: Gore

powers.description: Its hackles go up; it shrugs off the next few blows.
powers.name: Bristle

annotations.intent: Ambient wildlife for Thornwood. Place as neutral units so they never start a fight; there's no flee behavior yet, so a hit deer fights back. Easy kills, for 'hunt N deer' quests.

deer.description: A skittish forest deer. It only fights when cornered.
deer.name: Deer

powers.description: Lowers its head and shoves with its antlers.
powers.name: Antler Butt

dire-wolf.description: A huge, shaggy wolf: slow to bring down, and it doesn't let go.
dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf

powers.description: Hunkers down behind its shaggy coat.
powers.name: Thick Hide

goblin-sneak.description: A knife-artist that slips past the front line to stab healers in the back.
goblin-sneak.name: Goblin Sneak

powers.description: A vicious stab to an exposed back.
powers.name: Backstab

powers.description: A dirty blow that leaves the target dazed.
powers.name: Cheap Shot

goblin-wolfrider.description: A goblin on a mangy wolf, fast enough to run down anyone who kites.
goblin-wolfrider.name: Goblin Wolfrider

powers.description: Charges through the target, knocking it off balance.
powers.name: Ride Down

powers.description: The wolf howls, and both of them get faster at biting.
powers.name: Howl

panther.description: A black hunting cat that strikes from the shadows and goes for the throat.
panther.name: Panther

powers.description: Leaps onto the target, knocking it off balance.
powers.name: Pounce

powers.description: Rakes the target with its claws, leaving it bleeding.
powers.name: Rake

wolf.description: A lean grey wolf that hunts in packs and goes for the legs.
wolf.name: Wolf

powers.description: Bites at the legs, slowing the target.
powers.name: Hamstring
